notes: A named open exit is resolved through the C one_argument path and canonical movement emits the destination look plus origin/destination audience bytes.
Leading C fill words are skipped, so “enter the fountain extra” resolves the fountain keyword and ignores the remainder exactly as one_argument does.
A bare enter from a ROOM_INDOORS room emits the exact already-indoors refusal before scanning exits.
A bare enter from outdoors selects the first open exit whose destination is indoors and preserves canonical movement audiences.
An outdoor room with no qualifying open indoor exit emits the exact no-entrance refusal.
After sleep, the registered POS_STANDING dispatcher gate rejects enter with the C sleeping response before do_enter executes.
